headline: Year-round Baitik Resort planned to be built in five years
summary: A year-round ski and tourism resort, Baytik Resort, is planned for the village of Baytik within five years. Total investment is set at $200 million.
why: Large tourism infrastructure projects bring capital and construction activity into local economies and can attract investors in regional hospitality.
original_headline: Круглогодичный курорт «Байтик Резорт» планируют построить за пять лет
